object.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the object to receive meter data. This object must be a bus, an aux bus or a device.

description: Registers a bus, an aux bus or device to receive meter data. Only the Main Audio Bus is registered by default. Use \ref ak_wwise_core_profiler_getmeters to retrieve the meter data after registering. Every call to ak.wwise.core.profiler.registerMeter must have a matching call to \ref ak_wwise_core_profiler_unregistermeter.

examples.description: Registers a specific bus for metering. This is necessary to obtain the bus meter value with \ref ak_wwise_core_profiler_getmeters.
examples.title: Registering a bus for metering
